The big drag came from exports, slumping by 1.7% and reversing a 2.8% increase in the previous quarter. Let's look back at the last five Formula 1 winners at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez. Winning a race here is quite the challenge, especially with Mexico City sitting approximately 2,240 meters above sea level. The thin air affects the cars' aerodynamic downforce and drag, making the practice sessions more valuable for the drivers to get used to the changes. In fact, two of the last five winners of the Mexican GP started from third on the grid.

“CTE is an entirely preventable disease,” Christopher Nowinski, CEO of the Concussion & CTE Foundation, said. A study published Wednesday found that about three in four deceased NFL players from 2008 to 2023 had CTE. According to the study published in JAMA Network Open , researchers examined the donated brains of 396 deceased NFL players who died during that time period and found that about 93.5% had CTE. They also analyzed the death records of 1,966 NFL players in the same time period and found that overall, combined with the donated brains, an estimated 74.5% of them were likely to have the degenerative disease.

A powerful feedback loop could drive more warming than predicted. Climate change itself is increasingly fueling climate change. Rising concentrations of greenhouse gases are driving up global temperatures, setting off dangerous feedback loops that we have not fully accounted for in our climate models—or our emissions-reduction goals. Scientists have long warned that warming would propel further warming in various ways, but a growing number of observations and studies are at last providing a sharper sense of just how powerful these cascading effects could be. And, by extension, they’re showing how much faster the planet may warm in this century.

A new stat that considers the quality of defenses a pass game has faced It could provide important context and eliminate overpraising of a quarterback — and his aerial attack — against a cake schedule or over-criticism of others who faced a challenging slate of defenses. This new metric measures how every NFL pass game performs relative to how those defenses perform against the rest of their opponents. The idea with APEX (just like DIP, the defensive version of this metric ) is to provide a cleaner, more fair snapshot of each pass game's effectiveness by accounting for the quality of the collection of defenses it has faced throughout the season.

Next week's midterm elections could prove momentous for Social Security, with time running out to put the program on solid financial ground. Social Security trustees' most recent report projects that the program's main trust fund is on course to be depleted by late 2032, after which Social Security recipients would face a more than 20% cut in benefits. In effect, that means the burden of repairing Social Security will fall on both sitting and newly elected lawmakers. If Congress wants to avert what would amount to a devastating financial blow for millions of Americans, it will need to solve an issue that previous generations of legislators have punted on for decades.

The Court of Arbitration for Sport ruled that teams of Russian hockey players must be allowed to compete at World Championships. The Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) ordered the International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) to allow Russian teams back into major competition for the first time since the invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. The panel "found that the IIHF arguments citing safety, security and other concerns were not supported by sufficient evidence."
